notes:
The plans shown are under the "Human-first" / "Your Virtual Front Desk" view (live receptionists, lines 32-33). The page also has "AI-first" and "Hybrid" toggles (lines 29-30), but no prices are shown for them. The same plans appear again at lines 358-372.

Transfer destinations included: Starter 1, Basic 2, Pro 10, Enterprise custom (lines 39-40, 46-47, 53-54, 60).

No free trial is stated. Instead, every plan has a "30-day money-back guarantee" (line 61). The FAQ is inconsistent about it: it says "30-day" and "within 30 days" but also "in the first two weeks" (lines 197-198). Refunds are capped at $1,000, and overage is not refundable (line 199). A blog title mentions a "Smith.ai Free Plan" (line 341), but the pricing page lists no such plan.

Discount: "10% discount for subscribing for 12 months" (line 216). Service is month-to-month with no long-term contracts (line 201). Spam calls are not charged (lines 68, 206).

Add-ons are listed per call (lines 92-149, e.g., Book appointments $1.50, Call recording & transcription $0.25) and per month (lines 150-162: Business caller ID $10.00, Additional transfer destinations $15.00, Inbound call tracking numbers $5.00). Each additional CRM is $0.50/call (line 75).
